epidemiology_scenarios.scenario: Incomplete measles dose proxy vs measles dose
epidemiology_scenarios.exposure_definition: Children without recorded measles dose in EPI denominator; not infection status
epidemiology_scenarios.interpretation: Coverage contrast, not a disease risk estimate; denominator is aggregate and may not be a cohort.

root_cause_actions.pathway: Lack of exclusive breastfeeding under six months may increase vulnerability to MAM/SAM.
root_cause_actions.action: Strengthen breastfeeding counselling, early postnatal follow-up, and referral tracking.

root_cause_actions.pathway: Gaps in age-appropriate vaccination can increase susceptibility to vaccine-preventable infections.
root_cause_actions.action: Use defaulter tracing, outreach sessions, and antigen-specific register reconciliation.

root_cause_actions.pathway: Unsafe water, sanitation, and hand hygiene can sustain diarrhoeal transmission.
root_cause_actions.action: Add hygiene-promotion denominator and pre/post diarrhoea monitoring to the next reporting cycle.
